This home is perfect for multiple families. There are 2 full master bedrooms to pick from. Kitchen is fully stocked and renters love this amenity. Just a short walk to the pool and quick tram ride or walk to the beautiful white beaches and turquoise waters.

Trois A is a 3200 sq ft. home with 5 bedrooms, 4 1/2 baths and an easy walk to our 12,000 square foot lagoon pool and an easy walk or tram ride to our beautiful beach. The house is thoughtfully decorated and supplied with all the creature comforts of home including spices, and staples in the fridge.

You are going to love access to the community amenities when you stay here! In addition to the iconic 12,000 square-foot lagoon pool, you also have access to in-season (March-October) beach shuttle service. Don’t worry though, as the beach is not far at all from the home! Other beach communities including Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Grayton Beach are close by. You won’t want to miss out on the chance to visit here!

Main Floor
-Kitchen with barstools for 4 propane (grill on back porch)
-den with electric fireplace
-dining room for 10

-1st King Master and bath with separate tub and shower

-Outdoor seating area and eating table

*New 2022 no golf cart/LVV rentals allowed in Seacrest as well as no campers/trailers

Please note that our beach is privately owned among surrounding neighborhoods and can be more crowded during peak season. Please rent chairs before your trip to ensure more space and fun for your group.

Looking for a beach with more dunes and less people? Camp Helen State Park is a short 6-minute drive east.
Camp Helen State Park Beach
Camp Helen State Park BeachCamp Helen State Park Beach | Photo Copyright: Visit Panama City Beach

Camp Helen State Park offers a unique beach experience different from others in Panama City Beach. It is an ecologically impressive beach with the combination of freshwater and saltwater coming from the Gulf of Mexico, Lake Powell, and Phillips Inlet, which surround the park on three sides. Those who enjoy white-sand beaches with undisturbed natural beauty will appreciate this beach.

Swimming

The 183-acre park is a day-use area with plenty of activities, like swimming, fishing, and nature study. Most people enjoy Camp Helen State Park beach for the sand and sun and walking along the picturesque sand dunes.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
